newsitem.title: SWEDEN: TENNIS-SWEDEN NAME UNCHANGED DAVIS CUP FINAL TEAM.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SWEDEN NAME UNCHANGED DAVIS CUP FINAL TEAM.

text.p: Sweden on Tuesday named an unchanged team for the Davis Cup final against France later this month in a match that will mark the final professional performance of veteran Stefan Edberg.

Sweden's team consists of world number nine Thomas Enqvist, who has finished the ATP season in blistering style with victories in Paris and Stockholm, Edberg and doubles specialists Nicklas Kulti and Jonas Bjorkman, team captain Carl-Axel Hageskog told a news conference.
The final will be played in this southwestern town from November 29 to December 1. The team is unchanged from the one that beat Czech Republic in the semifinal.
The French have named Cedric Pioline, Arnaud Boetsch, Guy Forget and Guillaume Raoux in their team.
Edberg played his last individual tournament earlier this month at the Stockholm Open.
